lede: The most consequential item this week is the San Miguel County BOCC's special meeting Wednesday, where they'll consider changing the Area Median Income limits on deed-restricted properties in Pinion Park — a technical-sounding move that directly shapes who qualifies for workforce housing here. Also worth watching: the County Planning Commission takes up three Land Use Code amendments covering forestry, oil and gas, and geothermal energy, and the Ridgway Town Council meets Tuesday on disaster response tied to the Gold Mountain Fire, which has scorched nearly 40,000 acres and repeatedly cut off Highway 550.

notable.stake: AMI limit change on deed-restricted Pinion Park units could shift who qualifies for local housing.
